messages:
maria_sales: Quick heads-up — Prospect (FinReg Inc) needs a 3-day POC in a VPC with Dedicated pool burst capacity for compliance demo. They want guaranteed headroom during live demo window next Wed 09:00-12:00 PT.
eli_ops: Got it. Do we know expected qps and model?
maria_sales: They'll run a reranking + chat flow using realtime-llm-large, estimate ~60 qps burst, sustained ~10 qps. Sensitive logs must stay in their VPC.
june_sre: For Dedicated we can carve a temporary pool and enable burst credits. Need pool size, burst cap, and auth method. Also need to know if they want ephemeral API keys or service account with KMS.
omar_security: FinReg requires customer-managed KMS and private endpoints. No public keys. If we do ephemeral keys, they must be restricted to the VPC egress IPs and audited.
sam_ae: I'll confirm KMS and add it to the contract addendum. For pricing — are we expected to bill burst usage as overage or include in trial credits?
maria_sales: Sales prefers to include a small burst credit in the POC (up to 100k tokens) and bill overage if they exceed. Need ops to provision pool and create ephemeral key that rotates after demo.
eli_ops: Proposed config: temp-poc-regvpc pool: base capacity 2 GPUs (sustained ~10 qps), burst headroom +4 GPUs (handle ~60 qps). Burst window 3 hours with automatic cooldown. Autoscale policy: immediate scale when queued latency >200ms, max-scale replicas 6.
june_sre: That sounds fine. We need to set eviction policy to FIFO for fairness and ensure canary fallback to second-tier model (realtime-llm-medium) if capacity thrashes. Also add tracing hooks.
omar_security: KMS note: we can integrate with their AWS KMS key via cross-account grant. Need their ARN and security contact. Also require TLS mTLS for private endpoint.
maria_sales: I'll ask their infra contact for KMS ARN and confirm the demo window.
eli_ops: On the provisioning side I can pre-create the pool and prewarm kernels. For ephemeral keys here's the curl to generate scoped key (ops-only):

```bash
# generate ephemeral key for pool-scoped use (6h)
redwoodctl keys create --scope pool:temp-poc-regvpc --expires 6h --restrict-ip 203.0.113.0/24
```

eli_ops: Once they provide IP allowlist and KMS ARN, I can run the above and handover key via encrypted channel.
sam_ae: Pricing — Finance approved a one-off trial credit of $1,200 for this POC to cover burst. Overages billed monthly. Please confirm estimated token burn so I can annotate invoice.
maria_sales: Expect ~75k tokens for the demo. We'll try to keep within credit.
june_sre: Ops checklist for provisioning: 1) create pool temp-poc-regvpc 2) attach customer VPC endpoint + private DNS 3) configure KMS and mTLS 4) set autoscale/burst policy 5) prewarm models and KV cache 6) generate ephemeral key and rotate post-demo 7) add tracing and cost telemetry route to sales account.
eli_ops: I can do 1-2 today, 3 requires their KMS ARN and SRE help for mTLS — @june_sre can you pick that up tomorrow?
june_sre: Yep. I will coordinate with Omar on KMS IAM role and then with Eli for endpoint.
omar_security: I'll draft the minimal IAM trust policy and mTLS requirements and paste here when ready.
maria_sales: Great — timeline: provision by Mon EOD, prewarm Tue, demo Wed 09:00-12:00. If anything slips ping me.
deploy-bot: [provisioning] Pool temp-poc-regvpc created in staging (id: pool-09ab3c).
eli_ops: Nice — I'll sync with SRE to move to prod once KMS details land.
maria_sales: Thanks all. I'll collect KMS ARN and IP allowlist from FinReg and post here. :thumbsup:
